name: Kazoku no Kizuna
source:
Main character prepares to enter a famous university. On his 20th birthday he learns that his mother and two sisters are not blood related to him. He decides he can't trust his family anymore. And since trust is impossible anymore the best course of action is to make obedient slaves out of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公正在准备考入一所名牌大学。20岁生日那天，他得知母亲和两个姐妹都与自己没有血缘关系。他决定不再信任家人。既然彼此之间已经无法建立信任，他认为最好的办法就是把她们变成唯命是从的奴隶。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
